verses.geez: ስምዖን፡ ወልደ፤….ካህን፡ ዐቢይ፡ ወበሕይወቱ፡ ሐነጸ፡ ቤተ፡ ወበመዋዕሊሁ፡ አጽንዐ፡ ጽርሐ።
verses.translation: Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple:

translations.lxx: Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple:
translations.ron: Simon, fiul lui Onie, preotul cel mare, în viaţa sa a sprijinit templul Domnului şi în zilele sale a întărit locaşul cel sfânt.

verses.geez: ወከማሁ፡ ሣረረ፡ ዘይነውኆ፡ ካዕበቶ፡ ወገብረ፡ ልብሰ፡ ቀጢነ፡ ዘይትዐጸፍ፡ ካህን።
verses.translation: and by him was built from the foundation the double height, the high fortress of the wall about the temple:

translations.lxx: and by him was built from the foundation the double height, the high fortress of the wall about the temple:
translations.ron: Şi de el a fost ridicat zidul îndoit de mare, turnurile de la colţuri şi zidul din jurul altarului.

verses.geez: ወበመዋዕሊሁ፡ ሐነጸ፡ አንቅዕተ፡ ማያት፡ ወዐዘቅትኒ፡ ዘከመ፡ ማየ፡ ባሕር፡ ብዝኁ።
verses.translation: in his days the cistern to receive water, being in compass as the sea, was covered with plates of brass:

translations.lxx: in his days the cistern to receive water, being in compass as the sea, was covered with plates of brass:
translations.ron: În zilele lui s-a săpat casa apelor, un strângător larg ca marea;

verses.geez: ዘይኄልዮሙ፡ ለሕዝቡ፡ እምነ፡ ድቀት፡ ወኀሠሠ፡ አሠረ፡ ሀገር፡ ወቀተለ።
verses.translation: he took care of the temple that it should not fall, and fortified the city against besieging:

translations.lxx: he took care of the temple that it should not fall, and fortified the city against besieging:
translations.ron: El a păzit pe poporul său de cădere şi a întărit cetatea împotriva năvălirilor duşmane.

verses.geez: ወተሰብሐ፡ በሚጠቶሙ፡ ለሕዝብ፡ ወበመንጦላዕተ፡ አንቀጸ፡ ቤት።
verses.translation: how was he honoured in the midst of the people in his coming out of the sanctuary!

translations.lxx: how was he honoured in the midst of the people in his coming out of the sanctuary!
translations.ron: Cât de măreţ era el în şuvoiul poporului, când ieşea din templul Domnului!

verses.geez: ከመ፡ ኮከበ፡ ጽባሕ፡ በውስተ፡ ደመና፡ ወከመ፡ ወርኅ፡ ምልእት፡ በዕለተ፡ ገሃህ።
verses.translation: He was as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full:

translations.lxx: He was as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full:
translations.ron: Ca luceafărul de dimineaţă în mijlocul norului; ca luna plină în zilele ei;

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ፀሓይ፡ እንተ፡ ታበርህ፡ በመቅደሱ፡ ለልዑል፡ ወከመ፡ ስብሐተ፡ ብርሃን፡ በ[ቀስተ]፡ደመና።
verses.translation: as the sun shining upon the temple of the most High, and as the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds:

translations.lxx: as the sun shining upon the temple of the most High, and as the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds:
translations.ron: Ca soarele strălucind peste locaşul Celui Preaînalt şi ca arcul curcubeului luminând în norii slavei;

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ጽጌ፡ ረዳ፡ በወርኀ፡ ኔዎን፡ ወከመ፡ ዘይፈሪ፡ ኀበ፡ ሙሓዘ፡ ማይ፡ ወከመ፡ ሠርጸ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ በመዋዕለ፡ ማእረር።
verses.translation: and as the flower of roses in the spring of the year, as lilies by the rivers of waters, and as the branches of the frankincense tree in the time of summer:

translations.lxx: and as the flower of roses in the spring of the year, as lilies by the rivers of waters, and as the branches of the frankincense tree in the time of summer:
translations.ron: Ca floarea trandafirului în zilele primăverii, ca floarea crinului la curgerea apelor;

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ስኂን፡ ውስተ፡ እሳት፡ ዲበ፡ ማዕጠንት፡ ወከመ፡ ንዋየ፡ ወርቅ፡ ዝብጦ።
verses.translation: as fire and incense in the censer, and as a vessel of beaten gold set with all manner of precious stones:

translations.lxx: as fire and incense in the censer, and as a vessel of beaten gold set with all manner of precious stones:
translations.ron: Ca odrasla Libanului în zilele verii, ca focul şi ca tămâia pe căţuie;

verses.geez: ወከመ፡ ዕፀ፡ ዘይት፡ እንተ፡ ሠረጸ፡ ፍሬሃ፡ ወከመ፡ ዕንቊ፡ ክቡር፡ ውስተ፡ ሰርጕ፡ ወከመ፡ ዕፀ፡ ቄጵሮስ፡ ነዋኅ፡ በታሕተ፡ ደመና።
verses.translation: and as a fair olive tree budding forth fruit, and as a cypress tree which groweth up to the clouds.

translations.lxx: and as a fair olive tree budding forth fruit, and as a cypress tree which groweth up to the clouds.
translations.ron: Ca vasul cel de aur, bătut şi împodobit cu tot felul de piatră scumpă;

verses.geez: ከማሁ፡ ውእቱ፡ ሶበ፡ ይለብስ፡ ልብሰ፡ ክብሩ፡ ወሶበ፡ ይለብስ፡ ሰርጐ፡ ምክሑ፡ ወሶበ፡ የዐርግ፡ ውስተ፡ መዓርገ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወተሰብሀ፡ በልብሰ፡ ቅድሳተ፡ ስብሐት።
verses.translation: When he put on the robe of honour, and was clothed with the perfection of glory, when he went up to the holy altar, he made the garment of holiness honourable.

translations.lxx: When he put on the robe of honour, and was clothed with the perfection of glory, when he went up to the holy altar, he made the garment of holiness honourable.
translations.ron: Ca măslinul ce odrăsleşte roade şi ca chiparosul ce se înalţă în nori.

verses.geez: ሶበ፡ ይትሜጦ፡ ሥጋ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ እምእዴሆሙ፡ ለካህናት፡ እንዘ፡ ይቀውም፡ ውስተ፡ ምቅዋመ፡ ግብሩ፡ ወይቀውም፡ ዐውዶ፡ አኀዊሁ፡ ወይኬልልዎ፡ ወየዐውድዎ፡ ከመ፡ በቀልት፡ ተመርት።
verses.translation: When he took the portions out of the priests' hands, he himself stood by the hearth of the altar, compassed with his brethren round about, as a young cedar in Libanus; and as palm trees compassed they him round about.

translations.lxx: When he took the portions out of the priests' hands, he himself stood by the hearth of the altar, compassed with his brethren round about, as a young cedar in Libanus; and as palm trees compassed they him round about.
translations.ron: Când lua el haina măririi şi se îmbrăca în toată podoaba,

verses.geez: ወኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አሮን፡ በትርሲቶሙ፡ ወመባአ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ውስተ፡ እደዊሆሙ፡ በቅድመ፡ ኵሉ፡ ማኅበሮሙ፡ ለእስራኤል።
verses.translation: So were all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the oblations of the Lord in their hands, before all the congregation of Israel.

translations.lxx: So were all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the oblations of the Lord in their hands, before all the congregation of Israel.
translations.ron: Când se suia el la altarul cel sfânt, se umplea de slavă sfântul locaş, iar când primea părţile din mâinile preoţilor şi el stătea lângă focul de pe altar,

verses.geez: ወይገብሩ፡ ግብሮሙ፡ በውስተ፡ መሥዋዕት፡ ወያሤንዩ፡ መሥዋዕቶ፡ ለልዑል፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ።
verses.translation: And finishing the service at the altar, that he might adorn the offering of the most high Almighty,

translations.lxx: And finishing the service at the altar, that he might adorn the offering of the most high Almighty,
translations.ron: Împrejurul lui fiind cununa fraţilor; el părea atunci ca odrasla cedrului în Liban, şi ei îl înconjurau pe el ca stâlpările de finic.

verses.geez: ወአንሥአ፡ እዴሁ፡ በሞጻሕት፡ ወአውጽሐ፡ በደመ፡ አስካል፡ ወይሰውጥ፡ ውስተ፡ መሠረተ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ መዐዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ለልዑል፡ ለንጉሠ፡ ኵሉ፡ ነገሥት።
verses.translation: he stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour unto the most high King of all.

translations.lxx: he stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour unto the most high King of all.
translations.ron: Şi toţi fiii lui Aaron erau întru mărirea lor şi jertfele Domnului erau în mâinile lor, înaintea a toată adunarea lui Israel.

verses.geez: ወያነብቡ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አሮን፡ ወይነፍኁ፡ በቀርነ፡ ዝብጦ፡ ወያሰምዑ፡ ድምፆ፡ በዐቢይ፡ ቃል፡ ተዝካረ፡ በቅድመ፡ ልዑል።
verses.translation: Then shouted the sons of Aaron, and sounded the silver trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard, for a remembrance before the most High.

translations.lxx: Then shouted the sons of Aaron, and sounded the silver trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard, for a remembrance before the most High.
translations.ron: Şi slujind la altar, să împodobească jertfa Celui Preaînalt Atotţiitorului,

verses.geez: ይእተ፡ አሚረ፡ ኅቡረ፡ ያዐርፉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወይሰግዱ፡ በገጾሙ፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወይገንዩ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እግዚኦሙ፡ ለልዑል፡ ዘኵሎ፡ ይመልክ።
verses.translation: Then all the people together hasted, and fell down to the earth upon their faces to worship their Lord God Almighty, the most High.

translations.lxx: Then all the people together hasted, and fell down to the earth upon their faces to worship their Lord God Almighty, the most High.
translations.ron: Întindea la cupă mâna sa şi luând din sângele strugurelui,

verses.geez: ወይሴብሕዎ፡ መዘምራን፡ በቃሎሙ፡ ወይመልእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ቤተ፡ ዕበየ፡ ጕማ፡ ቃሎሙ።
verses.translation: The singers also sang praises with their voices, with great variety of sounds was there made sweet melody.

translations.lxx: The singers also sang praises with their voices, with great variety of sounds was there made sweet melody.
translations.ron: Vărsa la temeliile jertfelnicului miros de bună mireasmă Celui Preaînalt, Împăratului tuturor; atunci strigau fiii lui Aaron din trâmbiţele lor de aramă.

verses.geez: ወይጼልዩ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ልዑል፡ ወይስእሉ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለመሓሪ፡ እስከ፡ ይፌጽሙ፡ በሕገ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወይገብሩ፡ ግብሮሙ።
verses.translation: And the people besought the Lord, the most High, by prayer before him that is merciful, till the solemnity of the Lord was ended, and they had finished his service.

translations.lxx: And the people besought the Lord, the most High, by prayer before him that is merciful, till the solemnity of the Lord was ended, and they had finished his service.
translations.ron: Au făcut auzit glas mare întru pomenire înaintea Celui Preaînalt.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ወረደ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ እዴሁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ማኅበሮሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ለእስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ የሀቦሙ፡ በረከተ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ በከናፍሪሁ፡ ወከመ፡ ይትመክሑ፡ በስሙ።
verses.translation: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Israel, to give the blessing of the Lord with his lips, and to rejoice in his name.

translations.lxx: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Israel, to give the blessing of the Lord with his lips, and to rejoice in his name.
translations.ron: Atunci tot poporul împreună s-a grăbit şi a căzut cu faţa la pământ, ea să se închine Domnului său atotţiitorul, Dumnezeului Celui Preaînalt.

verses.geez: ወደገሙ፡ ሰጊደ፡ ከመ፡ ያርኢ፡ ልዑል፡ በረከቶ።
verses.translation: And they bowed themselves down to worship the second time, that they might receive a blessing from the most High.

translations.lxx: And they bowed themselves down to worship the second time, that they might receive a blessing from the most High.
translations.ron: Şi au lăudat cântăreţii cu glasurile lor în casa cea mare, s-a îndulcit viersul şi s-a rugat poporul Domnului Celui Preaînalt cu rugăciune înaintea Celui milostiv, până ce s-a săvârşit podoaba Domnului şi slujba Lui s-a încheiat.

verses.geez: ወይእዜኒ፡ ባርክዎ፡ ለአምላከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይገብር፡ ዐቢየ፡ በኵለሄ፡ ዘያነውኅ፡ መዋዕሊነ፡ እምከርሠ፡ እምነ፡ ወይገብር፡ ምስሌነ፡ በከመ፡ ምሕረቱ።
verses.translation: Now therefore bless ye the God of all, which only doeth wondrous things every where, which exalteth our days from the womb, and dealeth with us according to his mercy.

translations.lxx: Now therefore bless ye the God of all, which only doeth wondrous things every where, which exalteth our days from the womb, and dealeth with us according to his mercy.
translations.ron: Atunci, coborându-se, a ridicat mâinile sale peste toată adunarea fiilor lui Israel ca să dea binecuvântarea Domnului cu buzele sale şi, rostind numele Domnului, întru numele Lui să fie lăudat.

verses.geez: ወየሀበነ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ልብ፡ ወይ[ግበ]ር፡ ሰላመ፡ በመዋዕሊነ፡ ወበላዕለኒ፡ እስራኤል፡ በአምጣነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ዓለም።
verses.translation: He grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Israel for ever:

translations.lxx: He grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Israel for ever:
translations.ron: Şi ei se închinau încă o dată, ca să primească binecuvântare de la Cel Preaînalt.

verses.geez: ወተአመነ፡ ምስሌነ፡ ምሕረቱ፡ ወቤዘወነ፡ በመዋዕሊነ።
verses.translation: that he would confirm his mercy with us, and deliver us at his time!

translations.lxx: that he would confirm his mercy with us, and deliver us at his time!
translations.ron: Şi acum, binecuvântaţi pe Dumnezeu, toţi, pe Cel care face lucruri mari pretutindeni.

verses.geez: ክልኤተ፡ አሕዛበ፡ ጸልአት፡ ነፍስየ፡ ወሣልሶሙሰ፡ ኢኮነ፡ ሕዝብ።
verses.translation: There be two manner of nations which my heart abhorreth, and the third is no nation:

translations.lxx: There be two manner of nations which my heart abhorreth, and the third is no nation:
translations.ron: Cel care înalţă zilele noastre din sânul mamei şi face cu noi după mila Sa

verses.geez: እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ደብረ፡ ሰማርያ፡ ወፍልስጥኤም፡ ወሕዝበ፡ አሞሬዎን፡ እለ፡ ይነብሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ሰቂማ።
verses.translation: they that sit upon the mountain of Samaria, and they that dwell among the Philistines, and that foolish people that dwell in Sichem.

translations.lxx: they that sit upon the mountain of Samaria, and they that dwell among the Philistines, and that foolish people that dwell in Sichem.
translations.ron: Să ne dea nouă veselia inimii şi să fie pace în zilele noastre întru Israel, până ce vor fi zilele veacului, ca să întărească la noi credinţa milei Sale şi în zilele Lui să ne izbăvească.

verses.geez: ትምህርተ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወተግሣጽ፡ ጸሐፍኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ኢያሱ፡ ወልደ፡ ሲራክ፡ ወልደ፡ አልዐዛር፡ ዘኢየሩሳሌም፡ ዘአንቅዓ፡ ለጥበብ፡ እምልቡ።
verses.translation: Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem hath written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom.

translations.lxx: Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem hath written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom.
translations.ron: Două neamuri a urât sufletul meu şi al treilea nu este neam:

verses.geez: ብፁዕ፡ ዘይገብር፡ ከመዝ፡ ዘንተ፡ ወዘይጠብብ፡ ወየዐቅቦ፡ ለዝንቱ።
verses.translation: Blessed is he that shall be exercised in these things: and he that layeth them up in his heart shall become wise.

translations.lxx: Blessed is he that shall be exercised in these things: and he that layeth them up in his heart shall become wise.
translations.ron: Cei care şed în muntele Samariei, Filistenii şi poporul cel nelegiuit care locuieşte în Sichem.

verses.geez: ዘዘንተ፡ ገብረ፡ ኵሎ፡ ይክል፡ እስመ፡ ብርሃኑ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ አሠሩ።
verses.translation: For if he do them, he shall be strong to all things: for the light of the Lord is his path.

translations.lxx: For if he do them, he shall be strong to all things: for the light of the Lord is his path.
translations.ron: Învăţătura înţelegerii şi a ştiinţei am scris în cartea aceasta eu, Isus, fiul lui Sirah din Ierusalim, care a vărsat ploaie de înţelepciune din inima sa.
